name: Bikerei 701
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Bikerei 701 in Alpbach, Austria Discover the cozy charm of Alpbach, a picturesque village nestled in the heart of Tirol.
beschreibung: The Bikerei 701 in Alpbach, Austria is a charming restaurant that welcomes guests with a varied menu and heartfelt hospitality. The ambiance blends traditional alpine elements with modern flair, creating an inviting space for cyclists, hikers, and food lovers alike. The kitchen serves a thoughtful selection of regional classics like Tiroler Gröstl and Kaiserschmarrn alongside refreshing international plates, all crafted with fresh local produce. Bikerei 701 is an ideal rest stop in scenic Alpbach.
